articles.title: Russell to start from back of Singapore grid after penalty
articles.description: Britain's George Russell will start from the back of the grid in Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix because of a power-unit penalty from last weekend's race.

articles.title: Wet races and why future of F1 engines appears to be V8 turbos - Q&A
articles.description: BBC Sport F1 correspondent Andrew Benson answers your latest questions after the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.

articles.title: Bottas cycling from Malaysia to Singapore Grand Prix
articles.description: Cadillac driver Valtteri Bottas switches four wheels for two and opts to travel to the Singapore Grand Prix by bike.

articles.title: F1 needs to have hard look at itself - Sainz
articles.description: F1 "needs to have a hard look at" itself in the wake of unprecedented software glitches that affected the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, Carlos Sainz says.

articles.title: Mercedes better 'watch out - Verstappen 'imperious'  in Bahrain GP win
articles.description: The Chequered Flag Podcast's Sam Bird and Andrew Benson discuss Max Verstappen's impressive Bahrain Grand Prix victory, which secured his first win of the season.
